yaml:
# HISS storage observation (H2, user decision HD4 2026-10-15). Applied by Setup only where the cluster runs Longhorn
# (namespace longhorn-system and CRD volumes.longhorn.io present); elsewhere it is NotApplicable.
# Cluster Manager reads Longhorn's volumes, replicas, engines and nodes (read-only), and Prometheus may reach
# longhorn-manager :9500/metrics, which Longhorn's own NetworkPolicy otherwise admits only from Longhorn's pods.
# H-P6 (storage operations design 2026-10-19, M1): Cluster Manager also reads Longhorn's settings and backup targets
# (read-only) to say whether replicas may share a node and whether storage-level backup is possible.
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-storage-observer
  namespace: longhorn-system
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
rules:
  - apiGroups: [longhorn.io]
    resources: [volumes, replicas, engines, nodes]
    verbs: [get, list, watch]
  - apiGroups: [longhorn.io]
    resources: [settings, backuptargets]
    verbs: [get, list, watch]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-storage-observer
  namespace: longhorn-system
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: Role
  name: opensphere-hiss-storage-observer
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: opensphere-cluster-manager-runtime
    namespace: opensphere-console
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: opensphere-hiss-longhorn-metrics
  namespace: longhorn-system
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: longhorn-manager
  policyTypes: [Ingress]
  ingress:
    - from:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: monitoring
          podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app.kubernetes.io/name: prometheus
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 9500
